description: This file defines the Twig 'ArrowFunctionExpression' class, which represents an arrow function expression in the Twig templating language. It includes methods for constructing the object and compiling the arrow function into executable PHP code.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\ArrowFunctionExpression
classes.description: Represents an arrow function expression node in Twig, capable of compiling itself into PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an ArrowFunctionExpression node with an expression, parameter names, and source code line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the arrow function node into PHP code using the provided compiler.
